criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.status: verified against Purdue GIS and independently corroborated
criteria.evidence: Freshly opened asset; source identifies FID 218 / JNSN as Helen R. Johnson Hall Of Nursing. Mesh ground ring is compared to all 12 unique GIS vertices (maximum nearest-vertex error 0.000010 m). OSM way 117146488 independently names Johnson Hall of Nursing and its outline differs by about 0.876 m Hausdorff.
criteria.uncertainty: Purdue GIS is not a structural survey, and its Shape__Area attribute conflicts with the polygon ring area; the independent OSM outline supports the ring geometry.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.status: verified against authoritative campus geometry; not survey-verified
criteria.evidence: Saved mesh retains campus-world coordinates and the source ring orientation. Reopened bounds (X,Y,Z) are [[-176.5308074951172, -133.8341827392578], [201.2740936279297, 244.28768920898438], [0.0, 8.135000228881836]]; source ring and OSM independently corroborate the plan footprint. No unexplained object transform is applied.
criteria.uncertainty: Uses the repository local geographic approximation; no independent surveyed control points or dimensioned plan are available.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.status: strongly supported with residual classification and detail uncertainty
criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS reports three levels. The 2018 Indiana 3DEP tile has 2,497 class-1 surface returns within the footprint eroded by 3 m; median height above nearby class-2 ground is 8.135 m (interior p95 8.184 m). The 2018 orthophoto supports a broad flat roof. Reopened mesh roof is 8.135 m.
criteria.uncertainty: No class-6 building returns were available; class-1 returns are surface returns, not a dedicated building classification. Floor spacing is derived from levels, and small roof structures/parapet detail are not established.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: The render shows a three-level red-brown shell, regular punched windows, limestone-like bands, and a west-side glazed entrance/canopy.
criteria.uncertainty: The source set contains no legacy-building facade photograph, elevation, or dimensioned plan. Materials, window locations/rhythm, entrance side and articulation, and distinctive features are explicitly provisional. Appearance alone earns no source-evidence points.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: This evaluation ran after Blender reopened the saved asset directly. Scene='Building_massing_johnson_hall_of_nursing_jnsn_823fca7'; expected collection exists=True; mesh objects=1; mesh modifiers=[]; linked libraries=[]; external file images=[]. Building-specific raw source snapshots, metadata, measurement scripts, source record, and three renders are present.
criteria.uncertainty: Master-blend integration is outside this standalone asset grade.

source_images_and_documents_inspected: 2023 Indiana Commission proposal and replacement project page
evidence.prior_validation_comparison: Existing review/reopen_validation.json was consulted for provenance; this evaluator independently reopened and inspected the saved file.

findings.finding: Facade and entrance remain unsupported by direct historical imagery, plans, or elevations. All facade features are illustrative; this criterion receives 0/2.
findings.suggested_resolution: Locate a credible, identifiable image/elevation/plan of legacy Helen R. Johnson Hall and revise facade materials/openings/entrance only where supported; otherwise accept that the asset cannot meet the 8/10 evidence threshold under this rubric.

findings.finding: The 2018 roof-height statistic is robust but derived from unclassified class-1 surface returns because the tile has no class-6 building points; floor spacing is an estimate.
findings.suggested_resolution: Retain the stated qualification or cross-check with an independent elevation/LiDAR classification source.
